Scoped context on contextvars

nodrill

Provide a value once, use it anywhere below

  • Python 3.10–3.14
  • Zero dependencies
  • Typed · py.typed

A request id or a database handle set at the boundary reaches the code that needs it without every function in between growing a parameter it never reads. Thread-safe and asyncio-task-safe, because it is contextvars underneath.

Get started View on GitHub
$ pip install nodrill
app.py 
from nodrill import provider, use

def handle_request():
    with provider("request", user_id=42):
        render_page()          # signature unchanged

def audit():                 # five frames deeper
    log(use("request").user_id)
